description: This file contains helper functions and scripts used for testing and manipulating interactive rebase operations in a Git environment. It provides mechanisms to set fake editors, verify linear revision ranges, perform cherry-picks and reverts, and check rebase behavior, primarily facilitating automated testing of rebase workflows.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Defines a fake editor script to simulate user editing during an interactive rebase, allowing overriding commit messages and manipulating rebase sequences programmatically.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor that outputs only the rebase todo list, useful for verifying the sequence of rebase commands without editing.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Verifies that the revisions in a specified range form a linear history with the expected sequence of commit messages.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts any ongoing rebase and resets the repository to a clean state.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Performs a cherry-pick of a given commit message and tags the result.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a given commit and tags the reverted commit.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit with a specified message and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to editors remain unchanged after tests that involve rebase scripts.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Sets up custom scripts to test reword commands during an interactive rebase, ensuring commit authorship and todo list updates are handled correctly.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Validates that reworded commits have the expected content and order after a rebase reword operation.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Replaces the rebase todo list file with specified content to influence rebase behavior during tests.
